title: dracaena elliptica var. maculata
intro: Dracaena elliptica var. maculata, commonly known as the Dragon Tree or Coral Plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asparagaceae. The health benefits of the Dragon Tree include its ability to purify the air by removing toxic substances and its role in reducing stress and anxiety due to its calming presence. The plant's therapeutic actions include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever and rheumatism, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the Dragon Tree include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
